intended_application: Automating research, analysis, and client deliverables for sensitive regulated-industry engagements
organization: Management consulting firm serving healthcare and financial-services clients
business_need: Improve research efficiency, analytical productivity, and client deliverable preparation without compromising professional quality
users_stakeholders: Consultants, research teams, engagement managers, firm leadership, clients, risk and compliance staff
adoption_posture: Moderate / fast follower; evidence-led staged adoption
capabilities_constraints: Restricted client datasets, strict contractual confidentiality, limited approved tools, audit trails and mandatory expert review
risk_consequence_context: High-consequence errors in regulated-client analysis, disclosure of sensitive information, compliance and reputational harms
management_question: What restricted or pilot-only uses of generative AI are justified given stringent confidentiality and validation requirements?
time_horizon: Near-term pilot over 6–12 months; reassess broader significance over 3–5 years
additional_context: Hold the underlying technology and general significance criteria constant; only application risk and organizational constraints change.
